content.short: Firefly Labs is a fast, low-cost cross-chain bridge for moving assets between networks.
content.description: Firefly Labs runs a cross-chain bridge that moves assets such as USDC between networks quickly and cheaply, with an API and SDK for integrations. Blockscout's Unichain and World Chain app marketplaces list its bridge, and Stable's official ecosystem page lists Firefly Labs.
content.meta: Firefly Labs is a fast, low-cost cross-chain bridge on Unichain, World Chain and Stable.
